summary: The patch clears group status during custom paste and row removal and recomputes project-card dirty state directly from the paste handler. No introduced defect was identified.

evidence: public/admin_projects.js:151 clears the group status inside pasteRows before rerendering pasted values.
public/admin_projects.js:222 calls updateSaveState immediately from the custom paste handler after preventing the native paste, without waiting for an input event.
public/admin_projects.js:207-209 clears the group status when a row is removed; public/admin_projects.js:523 passes the card article into wireRows for project groups.
